description: Enabling workstreams that sit outside the kit's SC-### delivery backlog. Kit tickets stay authoritative in planning/BACKLOG.json.

workstreams.title: Repository foundation
workstreams.scope: Unpack the launch packet, preserve originals with checksums, repository conventions, licensing notice, security and contribution policy.

workstreams.title: Development environment and tooling
workstreams.scope: Pinned, checksum-verified CLI bootstrap; Node LTS; pnpm supply-chain gates; Docker, local Supabase and Ghost feasibility in cloud sessions.

workstreams.title: Dev log and delivery tracking
workstreams.scope: Timestamped dev log, sessions, evidence records, generated implementation status, integrity validators and CI.

workstreams.title: Project hub and branch previews
workstreams.scope: Static project hub (status, backlog, decisions, docs, dev log, visual codex) deployed to GitHub Pages for main and recent branches. Live once Pages is enabled on the gh-pages branch.

workstreams.title: Foundation planning readiness
workstreams.scope: Kit audit, current vendor and runtime research, foundation planning brief and open questions for plan mode.
